content: JUnit XML: <testsuites><testsuite><testcase> with <failure>/<skipped> children; natively parsed by GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, CircleCI. GitLab enforces 30MB/file, 100MB total per job for JUnit artifacts. It's the de facto lowest-common-denominator CI test-report format even outside Java/JUnit (Playwright, pytest, Jest, Go all emit it).
